parsed.rationale: All 11 members are unnamed extensions (name: "") on `EnvironmentValues` spread across 5 distinct packages — AppServices, Playback, WXUI, Wallpaper, and PlayerHeaderView — each injecting domain-specific keys relevant only to their own package (e.g., PlaylistServiceEnvironment, RadioPlayerControllerEnvironment, AccentColorEnvironment, PlaybackBlendMode, ThemePickerState). This is the idiomatic SwiftUI pattern for scoping `EnvironmentValues` keys to the package that owns them; consolidating them would create unwanted cross-package coupling and violate the encapsulation each package currently enjoys. The structural collision is purely coincidental — all extensions target the same SwiftUI type but carry unrelated domain payloads.
